title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-03
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
source: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's  w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row CC Seat 12)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience tape with excellent recording quality and a few standout moments like Shakedown Street, making for an overall positive listening experience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers are enthusiastic, noting that the audience source sounds almost studio‑quality thanks to Dave Cohen’s meticulous taping and transfer work. The show offers about a CD‑length of high points – highlighted by Shakedown Street and a stretch through Take You Home – while the remainder is solid but more routine.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong recording clarity (excellent audience source) and generally positive remarks outweigh the limited detail on overall show depth, yielding a rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as crystal clear; Cohen’s taping and transfer are praised, indicating a very clean audience recording with minimal noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: One reviewer suggests appending Shakedown Street to the start of the second set and taking a CD‑length segment through Take You Home, implying a natural flow for the highlight portion.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Enthusiastic shout‑out (“Jerry Forever!”) showing strong appreciation.
